single_screen.description: 1 Screen Per Page with deep granular wireframe view & flow annotations

four_screens_per_page.description: 4 Screens Per Page grouped by functional sub-modules with workflow arrows

modules.title: Module 1: Authentication & Access Control
modules.description: User registration for Fan & Organiser, multi-role credential login gateway, and error/lockout states.

screens.title: Register Account (Fan Member)
screens.desc: Public visitor signs up with Email, Google OAuth, Display Name, City & Transit preference.
screens.flow: Submit valid form -> S03 Login or S07 Fan Command Center

screens.title: Register Account (Organiser / Promoter)
screens.desc: Promoter registers with SSM legal company number, PIC contact, and uploaded SSM certificate PDF.
screens.flow: Submit SSM proof -> Undergoes automated business verification -> S18 Studio

screens.title: Multi-Role Login Gateway
screens.desc: Single login gateway with role tabs (Fan, Organiser, System Admin), Google OAuth, and remember-me session.
screens.flow: Evaluates authenticated role: Fan -> S05/S08, Organiser -> S18, Admin -> S27

screens.title: Invalid Login & Lockout Protection
screens.desc: Non-blocking security feedback: error alert banner, 3-attempt lockout warning, and 3-second auto-dismissing toast.
screens.flow: User corrects credentials or clicks 'Forgot Password' -> S03

modules.title: Module 2: User Profile & Preferences
modules.description: User profile management, RapidKL transit corridor preferences, and accessible logout confirmation.

screens.title: User Profile & Account Settings
screens.desc: Profile card with avatar, role badge, email verification standing, bio, and city location fields.
screens.flow: Save changes -> Updates user session; Navigation to transit preferences -> S06

screens.title: Transit Preferences & Safety Alerts
screens.desc: RapidKL LRT Sri Petaling & MRT line selection, concert night departure reminders, and anti-scam warnings.
screens.flow: Preferences saved -> Dynamically annotates Event Radar and concert detail pages

screens.title: Security Settings & Logout Modal
screens.desc: Password update, 2FA toggle, and centered accessible confirmation modal for session logout.
screens.flow: Confirm Logout -> Invalidates server cookie session -> Redirects to Landing (S08)

screens.title: Public Landing Page
screens.desc: Hero section, quick search bar, artist chips, featured concert carousel with trust badges, and category cards.
screens.flow: Search/Category click -> S09 Browse; Featured event click -> S11 Details

modules.title: Module 3: Public Discovery & Event Radar
modules.description: Search and multi-criteria filters, interactive transit radar, and comprehensive event dossiers.

screens.title: Browse Events Directory & Filter
screens.desc: Chronological concert directory with Category, Location (KL/Selangor), Artist, and Date filters.
screens.flow: Click event card -> S11 Details; Click 'Radar View' -> S10 Radar

screens.title: Event Radar & Public Transit Navigation
screens.desc: Interactive spatial venue matrix with RapidKL LRT Sri Petaling (Bukit Jalil PH5), MRT Kajang line, and walkway guide.
screens.flow: Select venue cluster -> Highlights upcoming concerts; 'Open Maps' -> Outbound navigation

screens.title: Event Details & Forensic Trust Dossier
screens.desc: Concert schedule, live countdown timer, ticket tiers, RapidKL transit directions, and 4-step forensic trust scorecard.
screens.flow: Click ticket button -> S12 Handshake; Scroll down -> S15 Community Discussion

screens.title: Outbound Official Handshakes
screens.desc: Security handshake modal before redirecting to official whitelisted seller (GoLive Asia), Google Maps, or Calendar export.
screens.flow: Proceed -> Opens whitelisted ticketing gateway; Cancel -> Returns to event page

modules.title: Module 4 & 5: Artist Profiles & Community Discussions
modules.description: K-Pop idol group rosters, member biodata, and event-anchored community discussions.

screens.title: Browse Artists Directory
screens.desc: Search idol groups, soloists, and bands; filter by agency (HYBE, JYP, SM, YG) and debut year.
screens.flow: Click artist card -> S14 Artist Profile & Member Biodata

screens.title: Artist Profile & Member Biodata
screens.desc: Group background, debut history, complete member roster cards (stage name, role, photo), and linked Malaysian concert tour dates.
screens.flow: Click upcoming concert card -> S11 Event Details

screens.title: Event Discussion Board
screens.desc: Concert logistics Q&A, 1-level threaded discussions, author role badges (Fan, Organiser, Admin), and archived status.
screens.flow: Click '+ Post New Question' -> S16 Composer; Click 'Report' -> S17 Modal

screens.title: Post Comment & Reply Composer
screens.desc: Comment composer with guidelines banner, 1-level reply indent, and anti-scalper immutability notice (no editing after posting).
screens.flow: Submit comment -> Appends to live discussion thread -> Visible to all fans

modules.title: Module 5 & 6: Discussion Actions & Organiser Studio
modules.description: Comment deletion, community scam reporting, and promoter studio management.

screens.title: Delete Comment & Report Suspicious Modal
screens.desc: Author comment deletion confirmation modal and community scam reporting modal with reason, details, and evidence URL.
screens.flow: Submit report -> Enters S27 Admin Scam Reports Review Queue

screens.title: Organiser Studio Dashboard
screens.desc: Promoter overview: SSM Tier-1 badge, 4 KPI stat cards, readiness checklists, and attention queue for held submissions.
screens.flow: Click '+ Create New Event' -> S20 Form; Click attention item -> S25 Fix

screens.title: Managed Events Directory
screens.desc: List of all promoter-submitted events showing operational status (Upcoming/Held), forensic trust meters, and action buttons.
screens.flow: Click 'Edit' -> S20/S25; Click 'Status' -> S26 Lifecycle Status Management

screens.title: Create Event Form
screens.desc: Event creation form: title, category, date/time, venue selector, ticket tier pricing builder, and mandatory evidence URLs.
screens.flow: Submit details -> S21 Poster Upload & Gemini Multimodal OCR

modules.title: Module 6 & 7: AI Vision & Forensic Verification Pipeline
modules.description: Poster multimodal OCR, automated 4-step forensic verification, and scored publishing outcome.

screens.title: Poster Upload & Gemini Multimodal AI OCR
screens.desc: Poster dropzone, Gemini Vision scanning animation, and auto-extracted field suggestions with confirm/edit toggles.
screens.flow: Confirm fields -> S22 Automated Verification Engine

screens.title: Automated 4-Step Pipeline Processing
screens.desc: Real-time stepper showing Step 1 SSM check -> Step 2 Venue confirmation -> Step 3 Whitelist check -> Step 4 Gemini OCR consensus.
screens.flow: Processing reaches 100% -> S23 Evidence & Score Breakdown

screens.title: Forensic Evidence & Whitelist Inspection
screens.desc: 14-point audit score breakdown: SSM entity match (+25), venue tenancy (+25), ticketing whitelist (+30), duplicate check (+10).
screens.flow: Inspect score breakdown -> S24 Verification Decision Outcome

screens.title: AI Consensus Scorecard & Decision Outcome
screens.desc: Dual routing decision: >=90% Auto-Publishes live to Public Directory & Radar; <90% Held for remediation and Admin review.
screens.flow: If >=90% -> S09 Public Directory; If <90% -> S25 Remediation & S28 Admin Queue

modules.title: Module 8: Lifecycle Status Management & Admin Governance
modules.description: Listing remediation, operational status updates (UC025), and administrative platform governance.

screens.title: Organiser Edit & Resubmit Held Listing
screens.desc: Remediation workbench for held events: replaces unverified Telegram links with authorized GoLive Asia URL and re-triggers AI audit.
screens.flow: Re-submit -> Re-triggers S22 pipeline -> Once >=90%, listing automatically goes live

screens.title: Event Lifecycle Status Management (UC025)
screens.desc: Operational status selector (Upcoming, Postponed, Cancelled) with mandatory fan broadcast announcement note.
screens.flow: Broadcast status -> Instantly updates Fan Saved Events, Notifications, and Event Radar

screens.title: Admin Command Center & Executive Dashboard
screens.desc: Executive oversight: 4 KPI cards (Total Events 24, Trust 98.4%, Queue 4, Alerts 2), review queue table, and real-time audit log.
screens.flow: Click 'Inspect' on queue item -> S28 Admin Verification Center

screens.title: Admin Verification Queue & Inspection Center
screens.desc: Side-by-side inspection: Organizer submitted poster & SSM proof vs Gemini Multimodal OCR data, with Approve / Request Proof / Reject actions.
screens.flow: Approve -> Publishes to Public Directory; Reject -> Flags organizer and cancels submission
